verdict.rationale: Circle documents an official CLI (Circle CLI) that lets users create/manage wallets, transfer, swap, bridge USDC, execute contracts, and discover/pay for services through a single command interface, explicitly targeted at agentic/AI-native workflows alongside the agent-stack and MCP integrations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the CLI's actual usage and no detail on installation, versioning, or command reference depth.
